basis: opening squad, fixture-adjusted projections, solved in overlapping windows and committed 37 gameweeks deep

chips.note: a third copy of Palmer: 3.6 if he returns his average, 3.6 on the sort of afternoon the chip is played for, which under the 20 points that makes a chip worth building around, but an unplayed chip expires at nothing

the bench averages 11.3 and reaches 11.3 if all four have the sort of week they are capable of, the best bench of the first half, which under the 20 points that makes a chip worth building around, but an unplayed chip expires at nothing
The best temporary squad moves only 3 of the fifteen; a Free Hit needs 5 or more changes.
No week in this half rebuilds 5 or more of the fifteen. A rebuild smaller than that is a transfer, and the free transfer makes it without spending the chip.
